commonPrompt: Create illustrations for one cohesive fitness-science teaching series in the style of Ranking of Kings. Only two recognizable male characters appear: Bojji is a short boy with short black hair, round eyes, a tiny golden three-point crown, cobalt-blue tunic, white belt, white pants and black round boots; never make him a tall adult. Despa is an adult teacher with swept-back blond short hair, narrow eyes, long nose, two small blond moustache tufts, a rust-red knee-length coat, white fur collar, beige pants and dark short boots; never give him long hair or a goatee. Keep their clothes, proportions and colors consistent. Use a clean 2D anime teaching illustration with fine dark-gray outlines, flat colors and only light soft shading; no photorealism, 3D render, thick paint or advertising lighting. Every image has a truly transparent PNG background: all unpainted pixels must have alpha 0. Do not render or embed a gray or white checkerboard. No floor, paper, background, frame, white sticker edge, shadow, logo, watermark, Chinese text, English text or numbers. White pants and white fur collar remain opaque white. Keep full bodies, feet, equipment and required objects at least six percent inside the edge. No extra people. Make each scene explain just one training relationship, using accurate equipment and safe, controlled technique.
